content.text:
Catalog search now ignores accents in both the query and the catalogued text, so `garcia marquez` finds García Márquez. All 61 tests pass: the 60 existing ones plus a new one.

The fix is in `normaliseText` in `lib/helpers/text.js`. It now decomposes the text and strips the accent marks before lower-casing and cleaning up punctuation. Search is its only caller. The new test in `test/catalog.test.js` covers:

- `garcia marquez`, `GARCÍA MÁRQUEZ` and `anos` all matching "Cien años de soledad" by Gabriel García Márquez.
- `café` matching "Cafe Society".

Search results are still sorted by title as before. I didn't make sorting accent-insensitive, since you only asked about matching.

I haven't committed anything.
